note: Hungary: EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list). A third-country national performer works on the Hungarian Card, a residence permit that entitles its holder to stay and work, open to a performing artist (Act XC of 2023, § 36 (5) c), in force from 1 October 2026; its implementing Government Decree 35/2024, § 23). No permit is needed for educational, scientific or artistic activity of no more than ten working days in a calendar year (Government Decree 445/2013, § 15 (1) 16, in force from 1 July 2025), taken as 10 days within 365. Until 2026-11-04 this file said no days were named, having read only the Act and Decree 35/2024; Decree 445/2013 names them. All three read in the state's Nemzeti Jogszabálytár (njt.jog.gov.hu), which replaced the copies in Wolters Kluwer's net.jogtar.hu, a law database, cited until then as the state's.
